name: Texas Multi-Blind Championship Austin 2026

venue.name: Little Walnut Creek Branch - Austin Public Library

information:
The Texas Championship for Multi-Blind will be held separate from the main competition this year. There are two locations which will be happening simultaneously: [Austin](TXMBLDChampsAustin2026) and [DFW](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TXMBLDChampsDFW2026). See the [Texas Champion Titles tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TXMBLDChampsAustin2026#78973-texas-champion-titles) for more information.

The [Texas FMC Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasFMCChampionship2026) will be taking place at the same venue later in the day. Check out the competition page for more details, and consider registering for both!

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
